claim: Files under site/ are served without the script; it runs only for an address that is not a file
where: artifacts/soon/worker.js lines 2-4; README 'What is in it'
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/ (Routing behavior): 'if a requested URL matches a file in the static assets directory, that file will be served — without invoking Worker code'. Live: /v/a/ has no Set-Cookie; /, /no-such-page, /robots.txt, /_headers answer from the script (Set-Cookie: soon=...).

claim: _headers rules reach the pages the script returns
evidence: Docs: 'Custom headers defined in the _headers file are not applied to responses generated by your Worker code' (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/headers/); they reach / here only because worker.js line 32 copies page.headers from the ASSETS binding's asset response. Live / carries content-security-policy, x-robots-tag: noindex and HSTS.

claim: workers_dev = false means no workers.dev address
evidence: With wrangler >= 4.44.0 (deploy.cjs pins 4.114.0) preview URLs default to the workers.dev setting, so none are created (https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2025-10-23-preview-url-default-behavior/).

claim: The zone adds Cloudflare Web Analytics; the CSP allows that one script and its two endpoints
evidence: Live with a browser Accept header the HTML ends with a module script from https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/... (absent for curl's */*). Docs: automatic setup reports to the site's own /cdn-cgi/rum (connect-src 'self'), manual setup to cloudflareinsights.com (https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/faq/). No CSP console error in Chromium with the CSP applied.

claim: A Worker route can run in front of a Custom Domain Worker and in front of a Pages custom domain (the P11 gate options)
evidence: 'A Worker running on a Custom Domain is treated as an origin. Any Workers running on routes before your Custom Domain can optionally call the Worker registered on your Custom Domain by issuing fetch(request)' (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/custom-domains/); a Worker on the same custom domain 'proxies your Pages application' (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/how-to/add-custom-http-headers/).

claim: What the gate does when the free daily allowance runs out is a choice (fail open or closed)
evidence: Workers Free: 100,000 requests/day, Error 1027 beyond; 'Fail open: Bypasses the Worker' / 'Fail closed: Returns a Cloudflare 1027 error page', set per route (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#daily-requests). Pages Functions: 'Fail open means that static assets will continue to be served, even if Pages Functions would ordinarily have run first' (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/routing/); Function requests count against the same 100,000 (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/pricing/).

claim: In maintenance the domain answers 503 with Retry-After, so a search engine keeps what it has; the hour is for crawlers
evidence: Google: 5xx 'prompt Google's crawlers to temporarily slow down' and 'already indexed URLs are preserved in the index, but eventually dropped'; the page does not mention Retry-After (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/http-network-errors). The 503 part holds for a short window; that Google reads the hour is not documented.

claim: noindex makes Google drop a page already in results
where: artifacts/soon/site/_headers line 12 (and its reuse by the planned gate)
evidence: 'When Googlebot crawls that page and extracts the tag or header, Google will drop that page entirely from Google Search results' (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/block-indexing).

claim: The gate remembers the state for 30 seconds per isolate
evidence: Isolates are reused across requests but not necessarily long-lived, and concurrent requests share one isolate; an I/O object (a fetch promise or Response) kept in global scope and used by another request fails with Cannot perform I/O on behalf of a different request, so the cache must hold the word and its time, not the in-flight fetch (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/reference/how-workers-works/, https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/errors/). Each isolate reads on its own, so propagation is within 30 s plus the 1.5 s timeout.

claim: A Pages Function with _routes.json can be limited to pages so files never invoke it
evidence: Functions invocation routes: include/exclude rules, at least one include, at most 100 rules of 100 characters; a request is static (free, unlimited, and still served under fail-closed) when it does not invoke Functions (https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/routing/, https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/pricing/). Excluding the exempt paths (/admin, /admin/*, /orders, /checkout/return, /notify/*) as well keeps the owner and buyers reachable even when the allowance is exhausted under fail-closed.
